abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Alvenor. Overall, Brostamide and Alvenor reach about the same side effects.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Alvenor. Overall, Brostamide and Alvenor reach about the same side effects.
section:
### Additional comparison

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Riverside Pressure Registry.
